exposure: MCDA twin pregnancy conceived through assisted reproductive techniques (ART)
monochorionic diamniotic (MCDA) twin pregnancies conceived through assisted reproductive techniques (ART)
Monochorionic diamniotic (MCDA) twin pregnancy conceived naturally
monochorionic diamniotic (MCDA) twin pregnancies conceived naturally
cohort: All MCDA twin pregnancies that received obstetric care and delivered at La Fe University and Polytechnic Hospital between 2015 and 2021.
finding: Compared with naturally conceived MCDA twin pregnancies, those conceived through ART displayed a significantly higher risk of developing gestational diabetes.
mod_finding: MCDA pregnancies through natural conception had a greater rate of vaginal delivery than MCDA through ART.
